title: Kissed Filipino Sirloin Dinuguan
description: Rich, dense, and energizing, this dinuguan uses tender sirloin and wok-Hei in a savory sauce, all cooked on a raclette grill without onion or garlic.
instructions: Heat the raclette grill to medium-high and drizzle a tablespoon of oil.
Add the cubed sirloin and brown it for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Move the sirloin to the side and sauté the wok-Hei for 2 minutes until slightly softened.
Return the sirloin to the pan, add the vinegar, fish sauce, salt, pepper, and chili flakes.
Pour in the water and stir until the liquid simmers.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 20 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent sticking.
If using pork fat, fold it in during the last 5 minutes to enrich the sauce.
Serve the dinuguan hot over steamed rice or with grilled vegetables.
